title: Bonbon: 185 Candy World Sound Effects
shortText: 185 candy sounds: 8 candies by 5 actions, chocolate rivers, bubbles, machines.
html:
Bonbon is 185 candy world sound effects for Unity, Unreal, Godot, GameMaker and any game engine, with 14 seamless loops in WAV and OGG.

8 candies that each answer the same 5 actions, so a game wires one candy and swaps only the material, plus the places and the machines of the factory. Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. A free demo of 19 sounds is on this page.

@@IMG:shot_0_a_level.gif@@

What is inside

185 sounds · 14 seamless loops · 6 ladders · 5 machines · WAV + OGG · 19 sound free demo

  • Candy by action (80 files): chocolate, marshmallow, licorice, gummy, jelly, cotton candy, hard candy and sugar glass, each answering collect, land on, bounce, bite and break, with two takes per cell.
  • Bubbles, cracks and streaks (28): a bubble blown and popped at 5 sizes, a jawbreaker and a sugar glass bridge cracking in 4 stages, a 6 step collect streak and sweets poured by the handful.
  • The candy world (9 loops): chocolate river, caramel bog, soda spring, sprinkle rain, rock candy cave, jelly lake, wind over the sugar dunes, frosting falls and candy factory floor.
  • The candy factory (24, 5 loops): a taffy puller, a conveyor, a wrapping machine, a cotton candy spinner and a sugar rush power up that each start, run and stop, plus a gumball machine and a sweets jar.
  • Treats and wrappers (27): wrapper crinkles, candy cane snaps, lollipop licks and crunches, a licorice whip, sugar cubes, sprinkles and popping candy.
  • Syrup, soda and sugar (17): frosting squirts, syrup drips and plops, a plunge into the chocolate, a foot pulled out of caramel, a soda opening and a soda geyser.

Works with

Unity, Unreal, Godot 4, GameMaker, RPG Maker and HTML5: use the WAV or OGG files directly. Loop points are written into every loop file. Import notes are in the readme.

Try it free

The demo holds gummy across all 5 actions, two more candies, both ends of the bubble and the streak, the taffy puller from start to stop and two places.

Licence and how it was made

Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. Do not resell the sounds as a pack. Every sound is synthesised in code, with no generative audio model, samples or recordings. The code and the cover were made with AI tools. There is no music, no jingle and no voice here.

More from the same studio

  • Tumbler: Puzzle Feedback Sound Effects, the match and combo feedback this pack leaves out.
  • Hearthlight 02: Cozy Kitchen Cooking Sound Effects, for a bakery next door.

Made by Core Systems Asset Factory.
